hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/edisto-beach/camping ('two campgrounds with water and electrical hookups'; '50 Amp Service Sites: All of the standard campsites offer 20/30/50 amp electrical service'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 112 water/electric sites in two campgrounds, one ocean-side behind the dunes and one inland near the salt marsh (Live Oak), plus five walk-in rustic tent sites in Live Oak. Several sites take RVs up to 40 ft.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/edisto-beach/camping ('Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 112 sites'; 'Several sites accommodate RVs up to 40 feet'; 'These five rustic tent sites are located in the Live Oak Campground') + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/edisto-beach/campsites ('one more inland while the other overlooks the Atlantic Ocean and beach'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The tap water is high in salt but treated and safe to drink. Dump station gate open 6 am - 8 pm.

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/edisto-beach/camping ('Each campground is convenient to restrooms with hot showers'; 'Dump Station: Yes', 'Dump Station Gate Hours: 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.'; 'the water has a high salt content ... deemed safe to drink'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per the --AWH note, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (cumulative up to 42 of 49). Same-day reservations go through the park. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/edisto-beach/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/edisto-beach/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site'), read 2026-10-21; single-night waiver from the entry's --AWH note

summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site, 13-month window and 2-night minimum (now on the entry with the AWH phone waiver); sites 75 -> 112 (the 75 was read from the AWH note about the ocean-side sites; the park lists 112 water/electric sites in two campgrounds) up to 40 ft; added 50 A + water at every standard site, 14-night max, showers and dump. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note kept. Not stated: sewer, season, pull-throughs.
